concerns.text: User stories are labeled as “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, etc., but all functional requirements refer to “US‑1”, “US‑2”, “US‑3” (e.g., FR‑001: “(See US‑1)”). The identifier “US‑#” does not exist elsewhere, creating an unresolved cross‑reference and inconsistent terminology.

Functional requirements repeatedly cite “(See US‑1)”, “(See US‑2)”, and “(See US‑3)”, yet no sections or identifiers named US‑1/US‑2/US‑3 are defined in the document. This breaks traceability between requirements and user stories.
